issue312.title: [Proposal] Formal logical operators for workflow: decision node + edge conditions (AND/OR)
issue312.body:
### User problem
Workflows like `approval? -> approved / denied / retry` (see
`archify/examples/agent-tool-call.workflow.json:67-70`) can only express
logic in free-text `label`. There is no typed `AND/OR/XOR/NOT`, no gateway
node, no `guard`/`condition` field. Agents invent wording, validators can't
check exhaustiveness, viewers can't highlight active branch.
Checked on `v2.17.0-dev.1`:
- `archify/schemas/workflow.schema.json:280,335` — `nodes[].type` is
  `componentType` (no `decision`), `edges[].role` is
  `main|branch|async|return|error` with no semantics.
- `archify/schemas/lifecycle.schema.json:133` has `decision` as visual style
  only. `sequence` has no `alt/opt/loop/par`.
### Proposal (slice 1, workflow-only)
1. Add `decision` to workflow `nodes[].type` (or `nodes[].gateway: and|or|xor`
   — open to maintainer preference).
2. Add `edges[].condition: { op?: "all"|"any"|"none", value: string }`
   with `maxLength`, no expression language.
3. Renderer: diamond sigil reusing existing `decision` tokens, no geometry/layout change.
4. Validator (fail-closed, `showcase` only):
   - `decision` must have >=2 outgoing edges, each with `condition.value`;
   - duplicate `condition.value` on same source -> error with `supportedFixes`;
   - missing condition -> error, not warning.
5. One example + 1 compiler test + docs in `SKILL.md` authoring-contract reference.
### Non-goals
- No expression evaluator, no BPMN full gateway set, no auto-layout change.
- No `sequence` fragments (`alt/loop/par`) nor `lifecycle` guards in this slice.
- No schema v1 break: additive optional fields only, old JSON stays valid.
### Compatibility / rollback
- Additive: `additionalProperties: false` preserved, new fields optional.
- Failed validation returns stable `diagnostics[] code/subject/evidence/supportedFixes`, preserves last-good artifact per delivery contract.
- Rollback = omit fields, renders as today.
### Why not just labels?
Labels are not machine-checkable and diverge across agents. Typed conditions
enable `validate --json` exhaustiveness and future Route/Lens filtering without
inventing topology.
I can implement slice 1 with regression test + `validate`/`deliver` evidence
per `CONTRIBUTING.md`. Agree on `type vs gateway` naming first?

issue130.title: Parallel Join not behaving correctly
issue130.body:
### Describe the Bug

The parallel join does not behave correctly. It waits for the number of tokens equal to the number of incoming sequence flows. However, it does not ensure these are actually coming from all incoming sequence flows. (See gif)

### Steps to Reproduce

See GIF
![parallelJoin](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4279289/218479544-db2f7fc8-a999-43f9-a6df-abeba5f0becd.gif)


### Expected Behavior

> The concurrent paths can be joined using a parallel gateway with multiple incoming sequence flows. The process instance waits at the parallel gateway until each incoming sequence is taken.

https://docs.camunda.io/docs/components/modeler/bpmn/parallel-gateways/

I am not sure what the standard says, but I would hope it's the same ;) 


### Environment

Library Version: bpmn-js-token-simulation@0.33.0
